name: scientific-paper-recommendation-2015-2026-v2-arxiv
research_scope: Methods and evaluations for recommending related scientific literature
scope_change_from_v1: Add arXiv as a pre-registered provider while holding queries and temporal boundaries fixed
arxiv_language_policy: No language metadata is supplied by the Atom API; English frozen queries and manual audit are used
arxiv_version_policy: Preserve versioned source IDs, normalize work IDs without vN, and merge with a DOI work when arXiv supplies a DOI

sampling_policy_by_provider.openalex: top cited within each frozen query
sampling_policy_by_provider.semantic_scholar: provider relevance/citation behavior used by the scoped connector
sampling_policy_by_provider.arxiv: provider relevance within frozen date and category filters

deduplication: canonical DOI/arXiv/OpenAlex/S2 identifiers, then normalized title and year
